normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter has no independent semantics outside transfer; it only provides the index for the balance credit performed by this function.
The value parameter is only meaningful as the amount consumed by transfer's unchecked balance updates.
The spender parameter is only used to key the allowance mapping written inside approve.
The value parameter is only meaningful as the amount stored by approve into the allowance mapping.
The from parameter is only used to index the balances and allowances consumed by transferFrom.
The to parameter is only used to index the balance credited inside transferFrom.
The value parameter is only meaningful as the amount moved by transferFrom's unchecked arithmetic.
